input.title: Aster Port halts departures after channel collision
input.excerpt: A cargo vessel hit a dredger at Aster Port on September24. The collision blocked its only channel. All shipping departures are halted until tugboats clear the wreck.

input.title: Freighter blocks only shipping lane into Aster Harbor
input.excerpt: After striking a dredger on September24, a cargo ship obstructed the sole entrance to Aster Harbor. Port officials suspended arrivals and sailings while tug crews work.

input.title: Boreal port raises shipping fees next month
input.excerpt: Boreal port will raise docking charges by two percent from October1. The scheduled annual revision funds routine maintenance. Traffic is operating normally.

input.title: Eastmere grid failure cuts power to 800000 residents
input.excerpt: A transformer explosion on September24 shut down the Eastmere regional grid. Emergency shelters opened, rail service stopped and officials expect restoration to take two days.

input.title: Sable launches a blue case for Orion phone

input.title: Orion handset gains cobalt accessory

input.title: Sable recalls Orion battery packs after fires
input.excerpt: Sable separately recalled two million Orion battery packs after seventeen fires. Regulators ordered sales halted immediately. The recall covers all packs from the affected factory.

input.title: Council approves four billion dollar flood barrier
input.excerpt: Eastmere council approved construction of a four billion dollar coastal flood barrier after a decade of planning. It protects the city and should be finished in six years.
